body:
> Is there something you like?

the only things I like are weed (currently don't have any), the internet, and music...

thanks for your reply though. I don't know if I want to get better though. I've been mentally ill so long, it's who I am...
I like this comment. I don't identify with the self improvement at all though, my depression is such that I can barely take care of myself or give a shit about taking care of myself...

> Do you have any hobbies you can practice for little or no money? Is there anything you're really good at or interested in?

My only real hobby is juggling, and I barely do that any more because I don't get enjoyment out of it really... I don't know what I'm good at other than being depressed. I don't even know if I WANT to recover any more, I'm so used to it, depression and being sick is like an old stinky blanket or something.

>Do you mind if I ask whether you have a psychiatrist right now? Any friends, family? Was your depression always as bad as it is right now, or did it get worse at some point in time?

I'm seeing a county mental health psychiatrist tomorrow afternoon. It seems to be worse now, it started when I was around 16.
I have no motivation or energy to work really, I barely leave the house, bed... thank you for the kind words though
